biological_interpretation: KANSL1 depletion induces a selective posterior neuronal state touching vacuolar, endosomal, lysosomal and autophagy-transport biology without collapsing into generic NSL or OGT loss.
caveats: Kansl1 mRNA itself was not visibly depleted in the report, so guide identity is the engagement readout.
The Li et al. STX17 autophagy mechanism is relevant, but Stx17 and Snap29 mRNAs were not FDR-significant in this screen.
exact_observed_result: Kansl1 guides produced large signatures in posterior classes, with Ttc4, Nsmce2, Ccdc39, Commd4, Ctsa and Man2b2 repeatedly down and Dgkz up; Ogt and other chromatin-neighbor correlations were weak, not Kansl1 phenocopies.

prior_expectation.expectation: KANSL1 haploinsufficiency causes Koolen-de Vries syndrome and has published mouse links to autophagosome-lysosome fusion.

source_references.citation: Koolen DA, Kramer JM, Neveling K, et al. Mutations in the chromatin modifier gene KANSL1 cause the 17q21.31 microdeletion syndrome. Nat Genet. 2012;44(6):639-641.
source_references.description: Establishes that KANSL1 haploinsufficiency is sufficient to cause the 17q21.31/Koolen-de Vries syndrome phenotype and implicates neuronal functions.

source_references.citation: Koolen DA, Pfundt R, Linda K, et al. The Koolen-de Vries syndrome: a phenotypic comparison of patients with a 17q21.31 microdeletion versus a KANSL1 sequence variant. Eur J Hum Genet. 2016;24(5):652-659.
source_references.description: Shows that truncating KANSL1 sequence variants recapitulate the 17q21.31 deletion phenotype, supporting KANSL1 dosage as the driver of KdVS neurodevelopmental disease.

source_references.citation: Cai Y, Jin J, Swanson SK, et al. Subunit composition and substrate specificity of a MOF-containing histone acetyltransferase distinct from the male-specific lethal (MSL) complex. J Biol Chem. 2010;285(7):4268-4272.
source_references.description: Defines human NSL as a nine-subunit MOF/KAT8 histone-acetyltransferase complex and shows that MSL versus NSL complex assembly changes MOF substrate specificity.

source_references.citation: Dias J, Van Nguyen N, Georgiev P, et al. Structural analysis of the KANSL1/WDR5/KANSL2 complex reveals that WDR5 is required for efficient assembly and chromatin targeting of the NSL complex. Genes Dev. 2014;28(9):929-942.
source_references.description: Shows that KANSL1 is a scaffold for the NSL complex and that KANSL1-WDR5 interactions promote NSL assembly and chromatin targeting.

source_references.citation: Radzisheuskaya A, Shliaha PV, Grinev VV, et al. Complex-dependent histone acetyltransferase activity of KAT8 determines its role in transcription and cellular homeostasis. Mol Cell. 2021;81(8):1749-1765.e8.
source_references.description: Demonstrates that KAT8 in NSL catalyzes promoter H4K5ac/H4K8ac and supports transcription initiation at housekeeping genes, whereas MSL mainly controls H4K16ac.

source_references.citation: Chatterjee A, Seyfferth J, Lucci J, et al. MOF Acetyl Transferase Regulates Transcription and Respiration in Mitochondria. Cell. 2016;167(3):722-738.e23.
source_references.description: Reports that MOF/KAT8 and a subset of NSL partners localize to mitochondria and regulate respiratory-gene expression.

source_references.citation: Li T, Lu D, Yao C, et al. Kansl1 haploinsufficiency impairs autophagosome-lysosome fusion and links autophagic dysfunction with Koolen-de Vries syndrome in mice. Nat Commun. 2022;13(1):931.
source_references.description: Connects Kansl1 haploinsufficiency in mice to defective autophagosome-lysosome fusion through STX17 transcription and reports rescue of mitophagic and neurobehavioral phenotypes by 13-cis retinoic acid.

source_references.citation: Szklarczyk D, Kirsch R, Koutrouli M, et al. The STRING database in 2023: protein-protein association networks and functional enrichment analyses for any sequenced genome of interest. Nucleic Acids Res. 2023;51(D1):D638-D646.
source_references.description: Source database used to map the data-derived recurrent Kansl1 gene set onto mouse vacuolar, lysosomal, autophagosome, and transport annotations.

title: Kansl1 loss represses an endolysosomal/autophagy-transport core in posterior neurons
